project.title: [Company] — AI Scale Implementation
project.summary: Bespoke AI Scale deployment with custom voice agents, advanced CRM automation, multi-location support, custom integrations, and dedicated implementation.
objectives: Custom AI voice agents for complex call flows
Advanced AI CRM with custom pipeline, fields, and automation logic
Custom integrations (PMS, EMR, marketing tools, analytics)
Advanced lead reactivation and patient journey automation

included: Custom AI voice agent design and deployment (multi-scenario flows)
AI chat across all channels (web, WhatsApp, Instagram, SMS)
Advanced AI CRM: custom pipeline, fields, automation, reporting
Custom integrations: PMS/EMR, marketing platforms, analytics
Advanced lead reactivation: segmented, multi-channel, AI-personalised
Knowledge base build with AI training and optimisation
Dedicated implementation manager and go-live support
deliverables: Custom AI voice and chat agents (live)
Knowledge base with AI training data
exclusions: Phone number provisioning (client provides or ports)
Ongoing message/call minutes beyond included allowance
Third-party software licences (PMS, EMR, marketing tools)
Content creation for knowledge base (client provides source material)
Custom development beyond agreed scope document

timeline.notes: Bespoke scope; final schedule confirmed at agreement after discovery

vat.note: VAT status is unresolved; no tax determination is made in this proposal.

client_responsibilities: Provide phone number(s) for forwarding or porting
Supply treatment/pricing/FAQ content for knowledge base
Detailed CRM, automation, and integration requirements before build
Approval of custom workflows, message templates, and integrations before activation
Timely feedback during testing and optimisation phases
assumptions: Implementation fee is one-off; monthly fee starts at Go-Live
AI message/call minutes subject to fair usage within included allowance
No third-party costs beyond included allowance without prior approval
Bespoke scope requires a signed scope document before development starts
next_steps: Following acceptance, a commercial agreement and scope document are executed before invoicing
